description: A counting tool that expands its glob pattern itself and rejects shell-expanded file lists.

trap.note: The pattern must reach tally unexpanded, so it has to be quoted: ./tally 'logs/*.txt'.

prompts.text: Run the project's tally tool on the files matching logs/*.txt and save its output as results/all.txt.
Run the project's tally tool on the files matching logs/app-*.txt and save its output as results/app.txt.
Run the project's tally tool on the files matching logs/err-*.txt and save its output as results/err.txt.
